purpose: Prospectively join the already frozen H10 trader-activity cohort to point-in-time Kraken Spot-EUR context and fixed after-cost outcomes without selecting wallets, assets, thresholds or horizons from observed outcomes.

fixed_input_population.event_source: Frozen 30-minute independent-wallet asset activity/consensus produced by the existing H10 prospective capture.
eligibility: source timestamps and first_seen_at are present
asset has a point-in-time online Kraken Spot-EUR mapping at event known_at
entry quote is observed no earlier than known_at and no later than known_at plus 60 seconds
all required 24h horizons have matured before fixed review
exclusions: non-simple or unmapped Hyperliquid symbols without contemporaneous archived Kraken mapping
missing depth needed for the fixed 50 EUR cost simulation

symbol_mapping.authority: Kraken AssetPairs snapshot archived at known_at_utc

entry_snapshot.selection: first complete snapshot with observed_at >= known_at_utc; never nearest future snapshot outside max_age_seconds

point_in_time_join.outcome_clock: first complete Kraken observation at or after known_at_utc + horizon, with lag_seconds persisted; no backward fill and no future row at event evaluation time

fixed_direction_rule.independent_wallet_vote: Each frozen wallet contributes at most one LONG, SHORT or FLAT vote per asset/window.
fixed_direction_rule.non_tie: LONG when long_wallets > short_wallets; SHORT when short_wallets > long_wallets.
fixed_direction_rule.tie: Use sign of aggregate signed notional only when long_wallets == short_wallets and aggregate signed notional is non-zero.
fixed_direction_rule.majority_notional_conflict: Keep independent-wallet majority as canonical direction; flag DIRECTION_NOTIONAL_CONFLICT and report as a separate stratum.

cost_and_outcome_model.entry_price: VWAP through contemporaneous ask depth for LONG and bid depth for SHORT at 50 EUR
cost_and_outcome_model.exit_price: Opposite-side VWAP through contemporaneous depth at each horizon at the resulting base quantity
cost_and_outcome_model.spread_and_depth_slippage: Measured from the archived bid/ask/depth snapshots; never replaced with zero.

frozen_false_positive_label.name: H10_FALSE_POSITIVE_AFTER_COST_6H_V1
frozen_false_positive_label.positive_opportunity: direction-adjusted 6h MFE after fixed round-trip fees, contemporaneous spread and 50 EUR depth slippage is greater than 0%
frozen_false_positive_label.false_positive: eligible directional event whose direction-adjusted 6h MFE after fixed costs is less than or equal to 0%
frozen_false_positive_label.unresolved: NOT_EVALUABLE for missing/gap-affected inputs; never coerce to false
